_comment: All your accounts, one place, shared by every workflow. This is the minimum global config — everything workflow-specific lives in that workflow's folder. The channel set is open: add newsletter, threads, reddit, podcast, ... freely; runlog.py --channel is free text and a channel only needs an entry here if you want config for it.
_channel_keys: Optional per-channel keys the scripts honour: primary_metric (overrides the workflow's own for runs on this channel) and metric_delay_hours (how long after publish before the number is worth reading — due_metrics.py defaults to 72, right for social; set e.g. 336 for blog/Search Console, 24 for email replies).
_publish_note: Advisory, and an open set — no script enforces it. The contract is: a human approves before anything goes live, and the URL gets recorded. 'api' means the agent may publish directly after approval (sanctioned APIs only, e.g. Bluesky's AT Protocol); map any scheduler you already use onto the same contract.
